paper_level_summary_zh: 本文在相关工作部分简要提及[13]作为RFID-based声学窃听方法的代表，未提供详细的技术评价或性能对比。

evidences.evidence_quote: RFID-based methods have also been explored, with Wang et al. [13] showing how audio can be intercepted via RFID.
evidences.evidence_context: However, these systems are often affected by environmental factors and require expensive equipment to send and receive signals like mmWave, limiting their practicality.
